name: Container-Compose
description: A docker-compose like tool for Apple Container

issues.title: SIGINT/SIGTERM ignored during startup phase & healthcheck wait in foreground up
File `-f` option should be top-level like Docker Compose
compose down doesn't support named containers (or custom named containers)
Relative bind-mount volume paths resolve against process CWD instead of compose file directory

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: tolerate env-var placeholders and quoted scalars in deploy.replicas decoding by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/129
* Add shared ComposeProjectOptions by @adrum in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/138
* feat: error on unknown service name in `up` instead of hanging by @OrtegaMatias in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/139
* fix: make Main the root command instead of a passthrough wrapper by @subpop in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/149
* feat: add dependencyLevels scheduler for parallel `up` (#128, step 1) by @OrtegaMatias in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/144
* Change license to Apache 2.0 by @Mcrich23 in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/155
* feat: add/support stop_grace_period by @jpagh in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/150

## New Contributors
* @OrtegaMatias made their first contribution in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/139
* @subpop made their first contribution in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/149
* @jpagh made their first contribution in https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/pull/150

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mcrich23/Container-Compose/compare/1.1.0...1.2.0
